title: Unit 3＋Unit 6 自然与旅行联合测试

sections.name: 听力与听写

sections.name: 单词与词形
sections.focus: 自然与旅行词汇、词义辨析、单复数

sections.name: 四种时态
sections.focus: 一般现在时、一般过去时、现在进行时与将来表达

sections.name: 固定搭配
sections.focus: 介词搭配、景观测量、旅行常用表达

sections.name: 短文综合填空

questions.prompt: 写出录音中的单词。
questions.explanation: 录音为 plateau，意为“高原”。

questions.prompt: Where will the family go on Saturday?
questions.explanation: 沙漠天气太热，湖泊留到周日；爸爸最终选了瀑布。

questions.prompt: 写出录音中的词组。
questions.explanation: 录音为 square kilometre，注意单数 kilometre。

questions.prompt: What is the town famous for?
questions.explanation: 女孩说城镇以当地美食闻名，男孩提出的古建筑不是答案。

questions.prompt: What did Lucy lose?
questions.explanation: Lucy 的机票在手机里；她丢的是护照。

questions.prompt: Lucy’s flight leaves at ____ in the morning.
questions.explanation: 录音先提到原定 8:30，再更正为 9:30。

questions.prompt: The lake is ____ metres deep.
questions.explanation: 湖泊最深处是 eighty metres；18 是所看到的鸟的数量。

questions.prompt: The lake is ____ kilometres wide.
questions.explanation: 录音说 three kilometres wide。

questions.prompt: Why did Ben travel abroad?
questions.explanation: Ben 去国外了解不同文化，参观瀑布是旅途活动，并非主要目的。

questions.prompt: 写出录音中的词组。
questions.explanation: 录音为 good luck，用来祝愿好运。

questions.prompt: A ____ is a large dry area with very little rain.
questions.explanation: desert 指沙漠，关键是干燥、少雨。

questions.prompt: We climbed to the top of the hill and had a wonderful ____ of the lake.
questions.explanation: have a view of … 表示看见……的景色。

questions.prompt: The Great Barrier Reef is a natural ____.
questions.explanation: a natural wonder 是“自然奇观”；wonder 是可数名词。

questions.prompt: The ____ at the hotel gave us advice about the city they live in.
questions.explanation: local people 指当地人，与后面的“居住的城市”相符。

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: scenery 通常不可数；说 beautiful scenery，不说 a scenery 或 sceneries。

questions.prompt: We bought this suitcase yesterday. It is ____.
questions.explanation: brand-new 表示全新的。

questions.prompt: A kangaroo lives in Australia. Two ____ are standing near the tree.
questions.explanation: kangaroo 的复数直接加 s。

questions.prompt: One country has joined the festival. Now there are twelve ____ taking part.
questions.explanation: country 以辅音字母+y 结尾，复数变 y 为 ies。

questions.prompt: Beijing is China’s capital. London is the ____ of the UK.
questions.explanation: capital 在此指首都。

questions.prompt: One traveller has a map. The other three ____ have cameras.
questions.explanation: traveller 的复数为 travellers；也接受美式 travelers。

questions.prompt: Our school trip was last Friday. We ____ the waterfall before lunch.
questions.explanation: last Friday 将活动定位在过去，用 visited。

questions.prompt: Keep quiet! The guide ____ us about local culture.
questions.explanation: 祈使句及现场情境表明动作正在发生，用 is telling。

questions.prompt: My uncle usually ____ abroad in July, but he stayed at home this summer.
questions.explanation: usually 表示习惯；主语是第三人称单数，用 travels。

questions.prompt: We have booked the tickets. We ____ to Sydney next Monday.
questions.explanation: 已订票且时间为将来，可用 are going to fly。

questions.prompt: — Did the flight arrive on time? — No, it ____.
questions.explanation: Did 引导的一般过去时问句，用 did/didn’t 简答。

questions.prompt: There ____ two beautiful lakes here ten years ago, but now there is only one.
questions.explanation: ten years ago 用过去时；two lakes 为复数，用 were。

questions.prompt: We take photos on every trip. On our last trip, we ____ more than a hundred photos.
questions.explanation: 前句提供动词 take；last trip 要用过去式 took。

questions.prompt: Ella sees different views on her travels. Yesterday, she ____ snow-covered mountains for the first time.
questions.explanation: see 的过去式为 saw；yesterday 为过去时间。

questions.prompt: Tom buys a postcard in every capital he visits. In London last week, he ____ three.
questions.explanation: buy 的过去式为 bought。

questions.prompt: We ate local food yesterday. My brother usually ____ local food when he travels.
questions.explanation: usually 表示习惯，my brother 后用 eat 的三单形式 eats。

questions.prompt: The travellers are waiting at the gate now. One hour ago, they ____ at the hotel.
questions.explanation: 一小时前为过去时间；they 后用 were。

questions.prompt: The children look at a map before each walk. Right now, they ____ at a map of the lake.
questions.explanation: 前句提供 look at；right now 表示此刻正在看地图，用 are looking。

questions.prompt: Mei is interested ____ learning about different cultures.
questions.explanation: be interested in 为固定搭配，in 后可接动名词。

questions.prompt: This national park is famous ____ its waterfalls.
questions.explanation: be famous for 表示因……而闻名。

questions.prompt: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: abroad 是副词，go abroad 中不加 to。

questions.prompt: — I’m taking my English test tomorrow. — ____
questions.explanation: 考试前适合用 Good luck! 祝对方好运。

questions.prompt: The lake is ten metres ____. We cannot see its bottom.
questions.explanation: ten metres deep 表示十米深，bottom 指底部。

questions.prompt: The bridge goes from one bank of the river to the other. The river is fifty metres ____.
questions.explanation: 两岸之间的距离是河的宽度，用 wide。

questions.prompt: The nature park covers an area of eight square ____.
questions.explanation: eight 后用平方公里的复数 square kilometres；接受美式 kilometers。

questions.prompt: We learnt a lot ____ local culture from our guide.
questions.explanation: learn about 表示了解、学习有关……的知识。

questions.prompt: There are travellers from all ____ the world in this hotel.
questions.explanation: all over the world / all around the world 都表示世界各地。

questions.prompt: We arrived ____ the airport early enough to catch our flight.
questions.explanation: arrive at 常用于机场、车站等具体地点。

questions.prompt:
用否定句改写：They saw kangaroos on the trip.
They ____ kangaroos on the trip.
questions.explanation: 一般过去时否定句用 did not + 动词原形 see。

questions.prompt:
就地点提问：She bought her passport holder in London.
____ her passport holder?
questions.explanation: 地点用 where 提问；过去时用 did，bought 还原为 buy。

questions.prompt:
用词表中的固定搭配合并为一句：This town has wonderful scenery. It is famous for that scenery.
This town ____ its wonderful scenery.
questions.explanation: be famous for 表示因……闻名，主语 this town 后用 is。

questions.prompt:
用词表中的固定搭配保持句意：Learning about nature interests my brother.
My brother ____ learning about nature.
questions.explanation: be interested in 表示对……感兴趣，in 后接 learning。

questions.prompt: 根据短文填空，每空一词：The family travelled to ____.
questions.explanation: 首句说明一家人去了 Australia。

questions.prompt: 根据短文填空，每空一词：They visited Canberra to learn about its ____.
questions.explanation: 短文明确说去 Canberra 了解其 culture。

questions.prompt: 根据短文填空，每空一词：The bad weather changed their plan for ____.
questions.explanation: 原计划 Tuesday 去草原，因为下雨而改到下一天。

questions.prompt: 根据短文填空，每空一词：The writer calls the trip an unforgettable travel ____.
questions.explanation: 短文结尾原词为 experience，表示经历。

clips.intro: Welcome to the Unit Three and Unit Six English test. Listen carefully. Enjoy your journey through nature and around the world.
clips.l2: Girl: Shall we visit the desert on Saturday? Father: It will be too hot. Let us go to the waterfall instead. Girl: What about the lake? Father: We can go there on Sunday.
clips.l4: Boy: Is this town famous for its old buildings? Girl: No. People come here for its local food. The food festival is very popular.
clips.l5: Lucy: I cannot find my passport! Father: Is your flight ticket missing too? Lucy: No, the ticket is on my phone. Father: Does your flight leave at eight thirty? Lucy: That was the old time. It now leaves at nine thirty in the morning.
clips.l6: Welcome to Blue Lake. We saw eighteen birds on our walk. The lake is eighty metres deep at its deepest point. It is three kilometres wide.
clips.l7: Girl: Ben, why did you travel abroad last month? Ben: I wanted to learn about another culture. Girl: What did you do there? Ben: I tried local food, visited a waterfall and talked to local people.

reading: Last July, my family travelled to Australia. We first stayed in Canberra, the capital, to learn about its culture. We then flew to a small town. We planned to visit a grassland on Tuesday, but heavy rain kept us indoors. We went there the next day and saw kangaroos. At a local food festival on Thursday, I tried a dish I had never eaten before. Before we left, I wrote in my notebook: “This trip is an unforgettable travel experience.”
scope: Unit 3 Wonderful nature + Unit 6 See the world；结合小学基础词汇与语法
